settings.heading: No one-off custom orders.
settings.text: Murphy does not engrave single custom items at the shop, and does not take meetings for one item. Custom designs and logos are for larger orders of twelve pieces or more. Local pickup is available on large custom orders only, arranged after the order is approved. For a single item, order from the online store and add a name for $5.

settings.title: Murphy checks the artwork
settings.text: Vector is best: SVG, AI, EPS or PDF. A clean PNG also works.

settings.title: You get a proof
settings.text: An exact mockup and a firm price within 2 business days.

settings.title: You approve it
settings.text: Nothing is engraved until you sign off.

settings.title: It ships
settings.text: Most runs leave 7 to 10 business days after approval.
